why: Production orders with their materials, stock reservations, contractors, contracts, outsourcing and expenses, production BOMs, and the RPCs and event processors of the production workflow. Product kits (product_bom, create_product_with_bom_atomic) and purchase requests (purchase_requests, shared with purchasing and reorder) stay in core. Foreign keys from core tables (sales, transactions, purchase_requests) to production_orders install with this module; foreign keys between production and crm or expenses are in both modules' scripts and are added once both tables exist.
